name: Deep dive research

description.model: Researches each question across sources, claim by claim. Use when a Dive needs evidence for and against a thesis.
description.marketplace: Tiered sources, a source class, confidence and age on every claim, the fundamentals checklist for a token (usage, fees and volume, TVL, holders and liquidity, supply, control, catalysts, relative value), evidence for and against, and a mandatory skeptic pass before any conclusion.

triggers: building a thesis on one theme
checking a claim against primary sources
